annotations.title: Value an apartment building at today's loan rates

description: Runs the Worth Sheet valuation worksheet for a 5+ unit apartment building: from a rent roll and a year of expenses (or a known NOI) it returns NOI, expense ratio, value across your cap rate range, the price a financed buyer can carry at the latest 10-year Treasury plus a lender spread (80% LTV, 1.25x DSCR by default), per-unit value, and the refinance loan the income supports against your balance. An estimate from your numbers, not an appraisal.

admin_other_annual.description: Admin, legal and other expenses per year, US dollars. Put any lump-sum expense total (excluding property taxes) here. Default 0.

cap_rate_high_pct.description: High end of the cap rate range, percent, e.g. 7.

cap_rate_low_pct.description: Low end of the cap rate range brokers quote for similar buildings, percent, e.g. 5.5. No government source publishes cap rates.

dscr.description: Min debt service coverage, times. Default 1.25 (both agencies' term sheets).

insurance_annual.description: Insurance per year, US dollars. Default 0.

loan_balance.description: Your current loan balance, US dollars, to compare against the refinance loan. Optional.

ltv_pct.description: Max loan-to-value, percent. Default 80 (Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac conventional term sheets).

management_pct.description: Management, percent of collected income; charge it even if self-managed. Default 5.

noi_annual.description: Net operating income per year in US dollars, if you already know it. Give this or unit_mix (not both).

other_income_monthly.description: Other income per month (laundry, parking, fees), US dollars. Default 0.

payroll_annual.description: Payroll per year, US dollars. Default 0.

property_taxes_annual.description: Property taxes per year, US dollars. Default 0. With noi_annual, needed only for tax_reset.

repairs_maintenance_annual.description: Repairs, maintenance and turnover per year, US dollars. Default 0.

reserves_per_unit.description: Replacement reserves per unit per year, US dollars. Default 300.

spread_pct.description: Lender spread over the 10-year, percent. Default 1.75, the worksheet's placeholder (not a quote).

tax_rate_pct.description: Tax rate on the new value, percent of price (county millage as a percent). Default 1.5. Used only when tax_reset is true.

tax_reset.description: True if a sale resets the property tax bill to a share of the price; value is then solved with taxes at tax_rate_pct of price.

treasury_10yr_pct.description: 10-year Treasury yield to use, percent. Default: the latest daily par yield the site has (U.S. Treasury).

unit_mix.description: Rent roll by unit type, e.g. [{"units":12,"monthly_rent":1250},{"units":16,"monthly_rent":1500}]. Give this or noi_annual.

units.description: Number of units, for per-unit value when you give noi_annual.

utilities_annual.description: Owner-paid utilities per year, US dollars. Default 0.

vacancy_pct.description: Vacancy and bad debt, percent of gross. Default 5.

name: value_at_rate
title: Value an apartment building at today's loan rates
